narrative.northStar: One familiar place, four different ways to arrive
narrative.overview: User-approved board acfac1f applied in memory-loop-44w: inspiring Ground with full A.1; quiet Parchment Capture without a fake form; curious cool Think with a questioning IM Fell invitation; reflective Parchment Recall with Libre Baskerville editorial headings and Source Sans prose. Shared unchanged A.5/IM Fell identity connects all four. Prior no-art/single-font/uniform-dark adaptations are superseded. No future functionality, invented user content, generated artwork or external resource service is added. Accepted current-build typecheck/build, unit 25/25, Recall browser 26/26 and legacy browser 20/20; fresh visual SHIP and technical Accept. Backend 87 remains prior unchanged evidence. User navigation correction: the board’s compact top identity and horizontal real app links replace the permanent global rail and phone bottom bar. Shared identity appears once; independent Files sidebar stays. Reflow/enlargement can grow the page instead of clipping a zero-height workspace. Prior rail-layout captures are superseded. 44W-T1 initial unfocused pointer and natural keyboard operation at 844×390/200% text are independently verified; history/UI-001/002/003/MS4 remain intact. No real-vault or physical-device claim.
keyCharacteristics: Compact shared top identity and horizontal real links; full-width workspace, no global app rail or bottom bar.
Shared identity, four distinct emotional jobs.
Full approved artwork only where it has room; never behind note text.
Local IM Fell identity, Source Sans UI/prose, Libre Baskerville editorial headings.
Horizon location/dark focus, Night light focus, Lantern warmth/actions.
Honest unfinished tabs and unchanged safe read-only Recall behavior.

rules.name: The Purposeful Accents Rule
rules.body: Give warmth, curiosity, selection and focus explicit roles; color is never the only state cue.

rules.name: The Three Type Roles Rule
rules.body: IM Fell names/invites; Source Sans operates/explains; Libre Baskerville marks reflective editorial headings.

rules.name: The Content Code Rule
rules.body: Use the native monospace stack for actual code, not filenames, navigation, or a technical-looking interface costume.

rules.name: The Flat Surface Rule
rules.body: Separate work areas with fields, spacing, or a single rule rather than decorative depth.

dos: Do keep selection, keyboard focus, and unavailable-feature copy distinct.
Do preserve native links, readable wrapping, and document scrolling.
Do use local font files with their OFL and recorded provenance.
Do measure contrast for any new rendered color pairing.
Do keep app navigation reachable while Files or the reader scrolls independently.
Do preserve literal file identity, document semantics, and honest read-only recovery states.
donts: Don't crop, recolor or redraw approved artwork, or place narrative art behind reading text.
Don't turn visual invitations into simulated user content or future features.
Don't treat prior assistant restraint as immutable brand truth or panel ramps as runtime colors.
Don't change renderer safety, history, focus or reading restoration to achieve visual styling.
